title: Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok are now operational after widespread outages on Thursday (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)
summary: Ben Schoon / 9to5Google: Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok are now operational after widespread outages on Thursday — A widespread outage has taken out popular AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. — Update 8:49am PT: Services appear to be coming back online, with user reports dropping.
